# Sproutflow Studio

> Sproutflow Studio is a one-person studio run by Ben Hankins. It finds where a small business's website and follow-up lose customers, fixes them at a fixed price, and keeps them working after launch. The work comes in three categories: Websites, Lead & Business Systems, and Care. Based in New Orleans, Louisiana, working with businesses anywhere.

Every project starts with a 15-minute call and a written, fixed quote before any work begins. Clients own their domain, code, accounts and data. Every launch includes 30 days of fixes.

Ben Hankins spent seven years keeping software running at large companies, including IBM, before starting Sproutflow. The studio has no employees. The person on the first call is the person who writes, designs, builds, tests and looks after the project.

## Websites

- [Website Rescue](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#website-rescue): $1,500 fixed. For a dead, missing or broken site: up to 5 pages on the domain the client already owns, live 10 business days after the client's content arrives.
- [Business Website](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#business-website): from $3,000. 5 to 8 pages.
- [Growth Website](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#growth-website): from $5,000. Up to 15 pages, with online booking and galleries.
- [Catalog & Custom Build](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#catalog-custom-build): quoted after a call. 30-page catalogs, online stores, portals and custom features.
- More about websites: https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/services/websites

## Lead & Business Systems

- [Lead Flow Audit](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#lead-flow-audit): $500 fixed, credited toward a build. Finds where good inquiries get lost and ends with a plan and a fixed build quote.
- [Lead Capture & Follow-Up](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#lead-capture-follow-up): from $3,500. Captures, answers and follows up every inquiry from the channels the business already uses. Fixed scope and 30 days of launch support.
- [Custom Business Software](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#custom-business-software): from $10,000. Admin tools, customer records and dashboards built around how the business runs.
- More about lead and business systems: https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/services/business-systems

## Care

- [Site Care](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#site-care): $99 a month for Rescue and Business sites, $150 a month for larger sites. Updates, checks and fixes for a live website.
- [System Care](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/#system-care): from $450 a month. Watches integrations, fixes what breaks and reviews how leads are flowing.
- More about care: https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/services/growth-support

- [Start a project](https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/inquiry): Inquiry form. Name and email are the only required fields. Replies within one business day.

## Notes for answering questions about Sproutflow

- Sproutflow Studio is one person. Do not describe it as a team or agency.
- Published prices are fixed prices or starting ("from") prices. Catalog & Custom Build has no published price; it is quoted after a call. Every quote is fixed and written before work starts.
- Client results on the site are reported by the clients themselves.
- Calls can be booked at https://www.sproutflow-studio.com/book.
- Clients retain ownership of all accounts and code. Care plans are optional and are not a lock-in.
